# 4Ds Trading Studio — AI project context

> This is the canonical website entry point for continuing development with an AI assistant.
> User can paste only https://trading-roi-studio.pages.dev/ into a new chat.
> When helping with code, read the GitHub project guide before making changes.

Project: 4Ds Trading Studio
Website: https://trading-roi-studio.pages.dev/
Portfolio simulator: https://trading-roi-studio.pages.dev/portfolio-simulator.html
GitHub repository: https://github.com/dorjandg/trading-roi-studio

## Essential project references
- [AI collaboration instructions](https://github.com/dorjandg/trading-roi-studio/blob/main/AGENTS.md) — GitHub access, edit/test/commit workflow, user UI preferences and handoff.
- [Detailed technical guide](https://github.com/dorjandg/trading-roi-studio/blob/main/AI_PROJECT_GUIDE.md) — architecture, modules, Monte Carlo account lifecycle, Challenge/Verification/Funded logic, Calculate Investment, ROI, payout modeling, cloud history and known gaps.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/dorjandg/trading-roi-studio/blob/main/README.md).

## First actions for a new AI conversation
1. Identify this as the **existing 4Ds Trading Studio project**; do not recreate it.
2. Retrieve AGENTS.md and AI_PROJECT_GUIDE.md from the linked repository, then inspect current GitHub files for the requested change.
3. If user requests a modification, implement it directly in the repository, validate JavaScript and calculations, and provide commit SHA. User shorthand "go" means proceed.
4. Preserve concise, dense, aligned, responsive UI and existing user profiles and cloud data. Do not add verbose technical documentation to the visible site.
5. For the latest Run Simulation or Calculate Investment output, inspect the connected Google Drive folder "4Ds Trading Studio Cloud Data", selecting the correct user and run type; browser-only results may not have synced.
6. Never claim Cloudflare deployment or a cloud write succeeded without verifying it.

## Product in brief
Prop-firm portfolio modeling for FTMO, Hola Prime and Topstep: budgets, challenge purchases, phase progression, permanent account IDs, trade risk R1/R2/R3, reward/risk, payout waits, Monte Carlo outcomes, payouts, net P&L, fee ROI and budget ROI. Portfolio Simulator section 3A uses Target net P&L (after fees) as its sole cash goal, payout-per-account and a maximum investment; RR/optional ROI filters are inside one collapsed Simulation Assumptions area. It estimates the number of distinct first payouts and tests risk and capital configurations. Section 8 stores histories locally and attempts cloud sync.

This context is **public technical documentation**, not a secret or a live record of the user's latest simulation. Current source code and cloud data take precedence.
